verdict.rationale: Puzzle's AI Close documents AI agents that reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies during month-end. Separately, marketing describes automated matching of invoices to payments, reviewed by the user before anything is final. Evidence is limited to headline-level vendor claims, with no detail showing the agent runs the whole month end-to-end or produces a prepared close package. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end month-close workflow detail, explicit bank-transaction matching by the agent, an exception queue/flagging mechanics, a close-ready review package with sign-off flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
matching invoices to payments, pulling together what your accountant needs — described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
